improvements.rationale: A compelling meta description improves click-through rates from search results by clearly stating what Gideon does and the free trial offer. Open Graph and Twitter Card tags ensure professional, branded previews when the homepage is shared on LinkedIn, Facebook, or Twitter—critical channels for reaching business owners and professionals. Including the three free searches hooks visitors without overpromising.

improvements.suggestion:
Hero Headline: "Meet Gideon — Your AI Trade & Business Assistant"

Subheading: "Get instant answers, voice chat, and professional support for your business operations. Try three searches free — no card required."
improvements.rationale: This copy immediately names the product (Gideon), clarifies what it does (AI trade & business assistant), and highlights key value props (instant answers, voice chat, professional support). The subheading reinforces the low-friction entry point (three free searches, no card) to drive trial conversions. Concise, benefit-led, and builds trust without overpromising.

improvements.suggestion:
Q: What happens after my three free searches?

A: Once you've used your three complimentary searches with Gideon, you'll be invited to choose a membership plan to continue. Plans start at just US$2 per day, billed monthly or annually—with annual billing saving you 30 percent. As a member, you'll unlock unlimited access to Gideon's voice chat, your personal workspace, and professional trade and business support whenever you need it.
improvements.rationale: This FAQ directly addresses the most common friction point for trial users—what happens when free access ends. By clearly explaining the transition, pricing, and member benefits upfront, it reduces uncertainty, builds trust, and primes visitors for conversion before they hit the paywall.
